maps.name: The Blue Sea
maps.description: Surf through blue channels, sandy islands and sheltered shallows. Dark water conceals paths below the sea.

maps.name: Caves
maps.description: Explore boulder-strewn quarry floors and climb the broad stone terraces.

maps.name: Graveyard
maps.description: Ghost, Dark and Psychic Pokémon roam these graves at night (18:00–06:00 UTC). Bring a Silph Scope for unidentified ghosts. Daybreak returns visitors to Grasslands.

maps.name: Power Plant
maps.description: Explore humming turbine banks, a winding cooling hall and a secluded battery vault deep inside the abandoned power station.

maps.name: Safari Zone
maps.description: Explore 16 connected preserves, rocky trails and hidden routes. Catch Pokémon with Safari Balls, bait and rocks.
